purpose: Current contract for semantic card facts that can power web relations, filters, similarity, and deck synergy.
design_principles: The source of truth for card text remains data/processed/cards/normalized/cards_normalized.json.
The text inventory and taxonomy are analysis inputs, not feature outputs.
A single card text line can emit multiple semantic facts.
A semantic fact should represent one clause-level meaning: one trigger, one produced event, one payoff, one cost, one restriction, or one modifier.
Triggers observe events; effects produce events, resources, state changes, or payoffs. These must not be collapsed into the same fact.
Costs and restrictions are first-class facts because they matter for filters, synergy, and playability.
Every fact must carry direct evidence and a source reference back to a card line or text unit.
Unknown or ambiguous values should be explicit instead of guessed.

inputs.role: Source of truth for card identity, official fields, rules_lines, and effect_lines.
Programmatic inventory of real card language, normalized lines, parameterized units, and candidate families.
Reviewed semantic contract for roles, axes, and web uses.
Runtime registry for canonical roles, fact types, actions, events, outputs, relation types, and web uses.
Prioritization and coverage report for choosing which language families to model next.
Curated minimum expected facts for representative real cards.

semantic_facts.description: One semantic fact per JSONL row.

card_relations.description: Derived card-to-card relations built from semantic facts.

semantic_report.description: Coverage, ambiguity, and missing-language diagnostics for the semantic extractor.

card_relations_report.description: Counts, broad match diagnostics, and degree summaries for derived card relations.

runtime_registry.note: The arrays below are retained for compatibility during migration. New domain ids should be added to semantic_ontology.json first.

fields.schema_version: Schema version string, normally matching this file version.

card_snapshot.card_type_ids: Card type ids from normalized card.

source_ref.line_index: Zero-based line index, or null for official fields.
source_ref.unit_index: Zero-based inventory text unit index when available.
source_ref.unit_text: Original atomic unit text when available.
source_ref.normalized_unit: Normalized unit text from inventory when available.
source_ref.parameterized_unit: Parameterized unit text from inventory when available.
source_ref.inventory_families: Candidate inventory family ids for this unit.

fields.clause_group_id: Shared id for facts that come from the same clause or ability, for example a trigger and its payoff.
fields.secondary_roles: Optional extra roles when a fact is intentionally multi-role.
fields.predicate: Canonical action/predicate id, usually from canonical_action_ids.

payload.subject: EntityRef or null.
payload.modality: required, optional, may, must, cannot, static, replacement, prevention, or unknown.
payload.polarity: positive, negative, replacement, prevention, suppression, restriction, or unknown.

fields.web_uses: Array containing enabled_by, enables, similarity, filters, and/or deck_synergy.
fields.evidence: Shortest exact source substring that supports the fact.
fields.extractor: Provenance object with id, source_kind, contract, rule_id, and rule_version. Legacy string values are deprecated.
fields.confidence: 0.0 to 1.0 confidence in the semantic parse.
fields.notes: Optional human/debug notes. Should not be needed by the web layer.

minimum_quality_rules: Every fact must point to a real play_id and source line.
Every text fact must include exact evidence from rules_lines or effect_lines.
A trigger such as 'When a friendly unit dies' must emit trigger_observed, not event_produced.
An effect such as 'kill an enemy unit' must emit event_produced with a death/removal event, not trigger_observed.
Optional payments such as 'you may pay' must preserve optional modality.
Static modifiers such as 'Your tokens enter ready' must be represented even when no trigger exists.
Keyword reminder text can produce facts when it changes relations, but the keyword marker itself remains identity_or_descriptor.
If a line has multiple effects joined by 'then', 'and', or a cost separator, emit separate facts linked by clause_group_id.
